issues.rule: R34/PF3 (test coverage of advertised CLI tools) — observation, non-blocking
issues.description: The package advertises CLI tools (README + software-level commands.json type=tool: osmo-arfcn / osmo-auc-gen / osmo-aka-verify / osmo-config-merge / osmo-gsmtap-logsend + osmo-release.sh), but test_package exercises only the libraries (test.c + test_ohos_tls.c). Locally, the L2 version/help smoke of those tools is skipped by the harness (runtime library search-path limitation of the smoke runner), so the binaries are effectively unverified by the automated gates while L0/L1/L1e/L5 and the conan test_package all pass. Non-blocking by the CI harness gate table; recorded as an accepted limitation.
issues.suggestion: Optionally extend test_package to invoke one CLI tool with its library path set (e.g. osmo-arfcn --version via subprocess) so the advertised executables are actually exercised.
issues.fix_suggestion: Optionally extend test_package to invoke one CLI tool with its library path set (e.g. osmo-arfcn --version via subprocess) so the advertised executables are actually exercised.

issues.description: package_info() sets per-component libs (cpp.libs = [name]) but never sets the top-level self.cpp_info.libs. For a component-based recipe this is intentional and correct Conan practice, so this is only a literal-rule observation, not a defect.
issues.suggestion: No change required; optionally add a comment clarifying that libs are intentionally declared per component.
issues.fix_suggestion: No change required; optionally add a comment clarifying that libs are intentionally declared per component.

issues.rule: L4 scan warn (dangerous functions in patches) — non-blocking
issues.description: Local CI L4 security scan reports `warn: dangerous functions in patches` (L4_RESULT=warn). Per the audit gate table this class is non-blocking when the danger is already declared/known; the patches here are upstream test-tempfile plumbing (mkstemp/fdopen in the osmo_io test patch) plus config.guess/configure mktemp and umask changes, consistent with the declared intent.
issues.suggestion: No change required; the warnings are declared and non-blocking.
issues.fix_suggestion: No change required; the warnings are declared and non-blocking.

summary:
W4 Pre-PR re-audit of libosmocore 1.11.0 OHOS adaptation, regenerated after the tests/exec fix (patch set 24 → 25) and after the talloc cross-DSO abort problem was resolved inside this PR. Scope: branch feat/libosmocore-1.11.0 vs origin/main; 45 changed files (all under archives/l/libosmocore/ plus knowledge/drafts/E568, E569). VERDICT: PASS (P0=0, P1=0; P2=1, P3=2 — all non-blocking).

Re-verification method: the isolated reviewer subagent used for the first audit was unavailable (service overload), so this re-audit re-ran every gate locally against real artifacts and re-verified each finding of the previous audit individually; no finding is carried over unchecked. Previous P2 items are now RESOLVED: (a) all 25 patch entries in conandata.yml declare patch_type "portability" (`grep patch_type | sort | uniq -c` → 25 portability); (b) conanfile.py method order is now correct (export_sources → requirements → layout → source → generate → build → package → package_info, verified by line order 92/105/119/122/125/148/161/172); (c) README dependency list no longer advertises liburing as a consumed dependency (it is now documented as an optional backend disabled by --disable-uring).

Deception checks (category 1) CLEAN: test_package/test.c really calls and asserts real APIs across libosmocore/libosmogsm/libosmocodec (osmo_hexdump, osmo_str_tolower/toupper, osmo_bcd2str, osmo_sockaddr_str_from_str, osmo_ctx_init/osmo_ctx, osmo_mcc_from_str/osmo_mnc_from_str, osmo_amr_s_to_d) and test_ohos_tls.c genuinely exercises cross-DSO TLS variables (osmo_ctx/osmo_cbsp_errstr) with pthread isolation assertions — no print-only shells; test_package/conanfile.py builds and runs both executables via subprocess and raises ConanException on non-zero rc. (R8/PF5) `grep -rE '__OHOS__|__MUSL__|__BIONIC__' patches/` returns NOTHING across all 25 patches. (R19) no pre-compiled .so/.a/.o and no *.log/__pycache__ in the diff (`git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD`). (sha256) real official hash 8e8dbf5e7d6d705aa34461a4ab3a0bd57f6961582cef95a1aafef3c74604c6dc. (R40) adaptation is substantive (native-TLS model fix, talloc single-host symbol export, sockaddr_storage guards, getaddrinfo/SCTP narrowing, missing upstream header restore), not stubs.

Recipe quality (category 2): R37 first-time upstream version 1.11.0 (no suffix); R39 source URL is the official osmocom downloads site; R38 commands.json present at software level (type=tool); R32 no Linux-only os settings; R33 no bare CC/CFLAGS shell vars (AutotoolsToolchain); R6 configure patching matches the repo-wide accepted pattern. Patch inventory consistent: conandata.yml declares 25 patch_file entries and 25 *.patch exist on disk; 0018-src-gsm-kdf-crypto.h.patch is a legitimate /dev/null → src/gsm/kdf/crypto.h new-file patch (`@@ -0,0 +1,470 @@`). W2 atomicity fine: diff touches only archives/l/libosmocore/** and knowledge/drafts/**, no ci//scripts//templates//references//SKILL.md/SUMMARY.md, no feedback/ files.

Verification evidence: W3 local CI .ci-result.json (step=W3_local_ci, exit_code=0, log_sha256 recorded) and official CI #47971 — conan-build-test ✅, L0 ✅, L1 ✅, conan test_package ✅. Upstream tests: 95 test entities in total (94 check_PROGRAMS test programs + 1 integration script tests/osmo-auc-gen/osmo-auc-gen_test.sh, zero removal). `make check` runs the Autotest suite tests/testsuite.at: 88 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed out of 90 cases (skips produced by upstream's own AT_SKIP_IF: no kernel SCTP, io_uring blocked by seccomp); a further 7 check_PROGRAMS (auth/tuak_test + 6 VTY transcript tests) are built but not executed under upstream default configuration, because their runner (the ext-tests / vty-test target) requires the external osmo_verify_transcript_vty.py from osmo-python-tests. MANIFEST.yml documents both figures, consistent with reports/test-report.md. The talloc cross-DSO abort failure class (40~41 failures) is resolved in-PR by exporting talloc symbols from the sole host DSO libosmocore.so — no dependency-side change outstanding, and no dependency_missing state remains. Verdict pass; P0=0 and P1=0.
